title: Vanilla Vulkan
description: Optimization modpack based on VulkanMod. Pure Vanilla.
body:
# Vanilla Vulkan
**Optimization modpack based on VulkanMod. Pure Vanilla.**

### Pure Vanilla Minecraft
- Game logic is untouched
- No unnecessary mods

### VulkanMod
- Boost perfomance with **Vulkan API**
- Built-in **Borderless Fullscreen**

### Optimizations & Compatibility
- Additional **performance** with mods _(Entity Culling, More Culling, C2ME, Fast Noise, Lithium, etc.)_
- Every mod should work flawlessly with **VulkanMod**
